response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate, AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005 GROUP BY orderslink), with_mean AS (SELECT per_order.*, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio FROM per_order) SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, CASE WHEN overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN avg_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) END AS relative_ratio FROM with_mean ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
